versions.changelog: No user-visible changes in this version; no file changes detected.

Initial release of the online-shipping skill:

- Allows users to compare shipping prices from multiple couriers by province/city/district and parcel weight.
- Supports direct online shipping orders with pickup, order management, cancellation (before pickup), and filing/viewing support tickets.
- Provides intelligent recognition of full "name + phone + address" text into structured shipping details.
- Batch (CSV) and single-item queries supported; results sorted by price and exportable to JSON/CSV.
- Flexible address and courier inputs: supports regional abbreviations and courier names (Chinese, abbreviations, or API codes).
- Orders and tickets require explicit confirmation before submission to prevent accidental deductions or changes.
